desc: Parse H, W, X, P, Q, and the H×W strength grid.
Initialize `cur = S[P-1][Q-1]`, mark start visited, push its 4-neighbors into a min-heap keyed by strength.
Loop: while heap non-empty and `heap[0].strength * X < cur`, pop it; if already visited continue; else add to `cur`, mark visited, push its unvisited neighbors.
